entries.zh: 指引；引导、带路；教导（原件汉文三栏空缺，仅存西语词头）
entries.en: to direct, to guide; to lead the way; to teach (Chinese columns blank in the original)
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆空，zh 仅据 L 释出；L 中 'g.' 疑为 guía 之缩写。

entries.zh: 见识高明；明理、有判断力（字面作『高见』）
entries.en: discreet, judicious; of sound judgment (lit. 'lofty view')
entries.notes: R 栏 cān guên 与 高见 的官话读音不合，四栏未能互证。

entries.zh: 才质；天资禀赋，引申指明理有见识
entries.en: natural endowments, talent and temper; judicious, of sound judgment

entries.zh: 甜口；嘴甜、言语动听，善辞令
entries.notes: M 栏作 tỹ chāy（才）而非 甜口，R 栏次音节亦与 口 不合，次字存疑。

entries.zh: 洗身（沐浴）；引申为洗清自身、自辩告罪
entries.en: to wash oneself; (here) to clear oneself, to make excuse, to apologize
entries.notes: L disculparse 与 H 洗身 有语义距离，属以沐浴喻洗清、谢罪之引申。

entries.zh: 回话（原件录作 会话）；答话、当面陈说、辩白告罪
entries.en: to reply, to answer back; to explain oneself, to make one's excuse
entries.notes: H 录作 会话，然 R hūi huā、M hūē oē 均指 回话（答话、辩白），与 L disculparse 相合。

entries.en: to run, to rush; to go about swiftly
to walk, to go about; to run
entries.notes: R 栏作 chên Pūn，与 H 走 不合，疑混入 奔 之对音；M 栏另混西语 corra。

entries.en: to tread; to roam all over (the world)
entries.notes: R 栏 fā 与 踏 官话读音不合，M 栏次音节 pôih 未详。

entries.en: to consider, to deliberate; thought, reflection
entries.notes: H 栏字符有 虑/宪 之疑，取 虑，与 M lū、R lȳ 对音相合。
M 栏于 lūn 外另有 hŷ cū̃ hōng 三音节，未详其义。

entries.en: to expound and discuss; to argue, to dispute

entries.zh: 思虑；思量、反复考虑（含疑虑）
entries.en: to deliberate, to think over; to reason while doubting

entries.zh: 虎犇（犇即 奔 之异体）；往来奔驰、东奔西走
entries.en: to rush about like a tiger; to dash to and fro
entries.notes: H 作 虎犇（犇 疑），非经见之词；R 仅 hú 一字、M 首音 hōi 与 虎 不合，词义难定。
